title: Microsoft Ignite 2026 — San Francisco (Nov 17–20)
source: EST: moscone.com/events/microsoft-ignite-2026 (the venue's own event page) reads "November 17–20 | Moscone Center | San Francisco, CA, USA" and "November 17 - November 20, 2026"; registration-open coverage corroborates the same dates. Microsoft's own ignite.microsoft.com/en-US/home rendered no date text to this lane's fetcher, so this stays estimate pending an IR/primary confirmation. Discovered and checked 2026-09-06 during the msft-2026-10-27-print adjacency sweep; RE-CHECKED 2026-09-06 by this event's own initial research — ignite.microsoft.com/en-US/home again rendered only "Your home for Microsoft Ignite" with no date text, and Microsoft's own techcommunity registration-open post rendered "San Francisco" with no dates, so no microsoft.com primary states the dates to this lane and the estimate label stands on the taxonomy, not on doubt about the date
notes: Microsoft's flagship enterprise/IT conference and the venue where Azure, Copilot and agent-platform commercial announcements land. Filed as the next MSFT-specific catalyst after the FY27-Q1 print (est. 2026-10-27) — roughly three weeks downstream, and the first Ignite under the new two-segment reporting structure announced in the 2026-09-02 8-K. Structure (added by initial research 2026-09-06): an optional pre-day on Monday 2026-11-16 precedes the main conference, and this entry's point-date 2026-11-17 is a TUESDAY — the day the Ignite keynote has landed in each recent edition (2024: Tue 11/19 Chicago; 2025: Tue 11/18 San Francisco), so the tracked date is the likely keynote day rather than merely day one. Historically a product/announcement venue rather than a reliable price event, and initial research measured it that way: MSFT trailed QQQ in all three of the last three Ignite weeks (-1.27pp, -1.17pp, -4.20pp, n=3, descriptive only) while the keynote session itself was noise (-0.20%, +1.13%, -0.32% open-to-close). Tracked for narrative read-through, not as a tradable date. Every statement keyed to it inherits the estimate label.
